market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. RBA rate decision imminent with hawkish bias; iron ore weakness and housing correction weigh on sentiment. CBA/ANZ rate hike forecasts signal sustained tight policy. Expect volatility around RBA decision; ^AXJO likely to test lower supports. Gold miners and defensives outperform.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. 2027 recession odds rising, Intergenerational Report credibility questioned, consumer stress mounting. However, super contribution surge and digital pension scheme could support financial sector AUM. Gold and healthcare offer structural resilience. Property sector faces multi-quarter correction. AI/tech small-caps provide selective upside but with elevated risk.
